title: labels: create the new area labels, rewrite kept ones, trial issue types
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbabAdcWyApSTGBYJNY

Filing gate: child of epic #35205, filed by seat 1 on the maintainer's 「立一张专题卡，开始执行」 (2026-11-18 14:43Z). Source order: /mnt/project-files/pm-orders/objectstack/seat1/priorities-rollout-2026-11-18.md. ⛔ Not a claim.

Runs after children 1 and 2 merge.

- Create `area:build`, `area:ux`, `area:package`, `area:fleet` and `area:cloud`.
- Rewrite the descriptions of `area:ai`, `area:data` and `area:workflow`.
- Old labels are renamed or kept, never deleted: area:devpath, records, access, identity, auth, reports, files, api, automation, i18n and studio. Whether to delete them after the cards move is a separate question for the maintainer.
- Trial the Bug and Feature issue types on one card. The organization issue-types API answers 403 to this integration. If the trial fails, record that on #35205 and tell the maintainer.
- Add `area:fleet` to #35205.
